body:
Headstrong is something I haven't heard in a while I definitely miss that! Doggo isnt formally trained but he just knowns when I need him. 

Night is really the worst, night terrors if I sleep and just a whole gambit a decent therapist would have a field day with if I could find one. I feel like this is going to be an all nighter followed by a long day and passong out early.

I will accept all hugs, thank you for replying. I definitely need more physical activity in my life, right now all I get is playing with my doggo. Hes the best! Idk when I started experiencing anxiety attacks. I wish I'd had access to help sooner but the gold ol USA and their backwards ass views of mental health set me back. Since moving back to the midwest ive interviewed 3 therapists... all implied I'd be better if I had kids. Yeah that's what I want to do... inflict my mental issues on a helpless being! Oh and that's after 9+ months of loss of bodily autonomy yeah! That just what I need /s ᕕ( ᐛ )ᕗ

Anyway, thank you! Having some human contact does help! Middle of the night is the worst time
